title: This DPP hat will get you into Maximilian Raynor's LFW party
description: This week’s guest on the Scoop is IoDF CEO Leanne Elliott Young. In 2020, alongside Cattytay, Leanne co-founded what was then called the Institute of Digital Fashion as a tech consultancy for fashion brands. Their goal is to help people understand what things like digital product passports (DPPs) are and how to use them.
author: Elektra Kotsoni
content: Welcome to the Scoop: a weekly email series in which I quiz fashion insiders on the stories of the week. This will be a way for the Vogue Business community to synthesize and reflect on the latest headlines and get a little inside scoop every Friday.

title: Can Pauline Dujancourt Scale Her Brand Without Sacrificing Craft?
description: Ahead of her London Fashion Week show, the indie knitwear designer shares how she’s increasing production as demand for her hand-crafted pieces grows.
author: Maliha Shoaib
content: A week ahead of her London Fashion Week show, Pauline Dujancourt is juggling two things at once: the adrenaline of presenting her brand on the runway, and the reality of growing the business behind it.
